workflows.title: How to schedule a calendar task
workflows.purpose: Schedule a new compliance task, assign it to a team member, configure its frequency, and add it to the firm's compliance calendar.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click a day cell on the calendar grid to open the day details panel
Click "New Task" in the day details panel header
Enter the task name in the "Title" field
Select a due date using the date picker next to the Title field
Optionally enter task instructions in the "Description" textarea
Click the assignee dropdown and select an employee, or leave it as "Unassigned"
Click the recurrence dropdown and choose a repeat frequency (e.g. "Does not repeat", "Daily", or "Custom...")
Click "Add Task" to save and schedule the new calendar task

workflows.title: How to sync the testing calendar to an external calendar
workflows.purpose: Generate and copy an iCal subscription link to automatically sync scheduled compliance test deadlines with external calendar applications such as Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click "Sync calendar" in the top right of the calendar view to open the subscription dialog.
In the "Sync calendar" modal, choose whether to subscribe to "All tests" or "Only tests assigned to me".
Click "Copy link" next to the "Calendar URL" feed input to copy the subscription link to your clipboard.
Review the setup instructions for your external provider ("Google Calendar", "Apple Calendar", or "Outlook") to subscribe using the copied URL.
Click "Done" to close the dialog.

workflows.title: How to link a test to additional entities
workflows.purpose: Link an existing compliance test to one or more of the firm's business entities so edits and completion status stay in sync across them.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Tests
Click on the test row in the tests table to open the test details view.
In the test details panel, locate the "Entities" section and click "Link to additional entities".
In the "Link entities" dialog, select the checkbox next to each entity you want to link to the test.
Review the synchronization notice confirming that edits and completion status will stay in sync across all linked entities.
Click "Save" to finalize and link the test to the selected entities.

workflows.title: How to link a control to a policy section
workflows.purpose: Open a policy document, select a specific section, and link an existing compliance control to it from the inspector panel.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Policies
Click on a policy row in the list to open the policy details view.
Select the desired section from the document outline or click into the section in the document viewer.
In the right-hand panel, navigate to the "Linked controls" card.
Click "Link control" to open the link control modal.
Search or select the desired control from the "Select control" dropdown list.
Click "Link control" to confirm and attach the control to the section.

workflows.title: How to export all of an entity's testing data
workflows.purpose: Request a bundled export of an entity's tests, findings, and evidence for a chosen date range.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Tests
Click "Export" in the top right corner of the page.
In the "Export testing data" dialog, select the target entity from the "Entity" dropdown.
Select the desired time period using the "Date range" picker.
Select the items to include by toggling "Include findings" and "Include evidence attachments".
Click "Export" to generate and download the bundled testing archive.

workflows.title: How to bulk assign tests and categories to an entity
workflows.purpose: Assign multiple compliance test categories and individual tests to an entity in a single action within Testing program.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Entities
Locate the target entity in the entities list and click on the entity name to open its detail drawer.
Click "Assign tests" (or "Bulk assign") to open the test assignment dialog.
Under "Categories", select the checkboxes for each test category you want to assign to the entity.
Expand individual categories to inspect tests, or check "Select all tests" to bulk-include all tests within the selected categories.
Verify the assigned testing cadence and review settings for the selected tests.
Click "Assign tests" to save the changes and bulk assign the selected categories and tests to the entity.

workflows.title: How to associate a control with a risk's treatment plan
workflows.purpose: Open a risk's details drawer from the Risks table and link existing controls under the Treatment Plan section.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Risks
Click on the risk row you want to modify to open the risk details drawer.
Scroll to or select the "Treatment plan" section in the drawer.
Select "Mitigate" under the "Treatment strategy" options.
Click into the "Associated controls" selection input to view the list of available controls.
Select the desired control(s) from the dropdown list to associate them with the risk.
Click "Save changes" to update the risk with the associated controls.

workflows.title: How to correct how a policy's sections were parsed
workflows.purpose: Correct mis-parsed policy headings, hierarchy levels, or split sections using the update sections editor so corrections persist across future document uploads.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Policies
Locate the target policy in the policies table and click the row actions button (three dots icon)
Click "Update sections" in the dropdown menu to open the section hierarchy editor
Select the checkbox next to one or more parsed sections that need adjustment, or shift-click to select a range
Click "Shift left" to promote the selected section(s) up a hierarchy level, or click "Shift right" to indent them under the section above
Click "Merge up" to combine mis-parsed section fragments into the section directly above them
Alternatively, hover over an individual section row to use the inline shift left, shift right, or merge up action icons
Click "Undo" or "Redo" in the toolbar to step back and forth through section adjustments if needed
Click "Save corrections" to persist the hierarchy rules and re-apply them to all future uploads of the policy

workflows.title: How to change which entities a policy covers
workflows.purpose: Edit the set of entities a policy applies to, which cascades to add or remove the policy's derived risks, controls, and tests for those entities.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Policies
In the policies table, click the kebab (actions) menu on the row for the policy you want to change
Click "Edit entities" in the dropdown menu
In the "Entities this policy covers" dialog, check or uncheck entities in the checklist to add or remove coverage
Tick or untick the checkbox next to each entity's name to include or exclude it
Click "Save" to apply the new entity coverage (disabled if no entities remain selected or nothing changed)
Confirm the "Entities updated" toast confirming the new entity count is shown, which reflects the cascaded update to the policy's derived risks, controls, and tests

workflows.purpose: Replace or add the underlying document for an existing policy.

workflows.title: How to re-analyze a policy to regenerate its risks and controls catalog
workflows.purpose: Trigger AI re-derivation of risks and controls from an existing policy document to replace its current catalog.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Policies
Click on the row of the policy you want to re-analyze to open its detail page.

Click "Re-analyze" from the dropdown options.
Review the affected tests, runs, risks, and controls displayed in the "Re-analyze this policy" dialog.

Confirm the "Analysis started" toast appears and monitor the "Analyzing this policy" status banner until regeneration finishes.

workflows.title: How to manage test categories
workflows.purpose: Rename, archive, or re-file which tests belong to a category from a central management sheet.

Click an entity's row to open its Tests page
Click "Manage categories" in the Tests table toolbar
In the "Manage categories" sheet, click the pencil "Rename category" icon on the category row you want to rename

workflows.title: How to raise a corrective action during test review
workflows.purpose: Flag a questionnaire answer requiring remediation during a test review by assigning an owner, severity level, due date, and instructions before submitting the corrective action.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Tests
Click the test name in the tests table to open its detail page
Under the "Tests" review view, locate the question response requiring remediation and click "Requires attention"
In the "Requires attention" dialog, select the "Corrective action" option
Select the severity rating in the "Severity level" dropdown
Select the assigned employee in the "Corrective action owner" field
Select the resolution deadline in the "Corrective action due date" picker
Enter detailed remediation instructions in the "Corrective action" text field
Optionally enter supplementary context in "Add note" and attach supporting documentation with "Upload"
Click "Send for corrective action" to submit the corrective action and require resolution before test approval

workflows.title: How to acknowledge a business risk during test review
workflows.purpose: Accept a flagged issue as a known, acceptable business risk instead of requiring a fix, without blocking approval.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Tests
Open the test run you are reviewing so its questionnaire loads on the "Tests" tab
Scroll to the flagged question and click "Requires attention" beneath its answer
In the "Requires attention" dialog, select the "Business risk acknowledged" outcome
Select the risk's "Severity level" from the dropdown (optional)
Enter an explanation of why the risk is acceptable in "Add note"
Click "Save & complete" to record the business risk and close the dialog
Confirm the "Business risk acknowledged" outcome badge now appears under the question, and that approval is not blocked

workflows.title: How to reopen a resolved finding
workflows.purpose: Reopen a previously resolved finding from its detail sheet to set its status back to open.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Findings
In the findings table, click the "Status" filter dropdown and select "Resolved" to view resolved records
Click the row of the resolved finding you want to reopen to open its detail sheet
In the resolution alert banner at the top of the sheet, click "Reopen finding"
Confirm the "Finding reopened" toast notification appears and the status badge updates to "Open"
Click the "✕" button in the top-right corner of the sheet to close it and return to the findings table

workflows.title: How to schedule a new calendar task
workflows.purpose: Schedule an ad-hoc compliance task on the testing calendar with a title, due date, assignee, and optional recurrence schedule.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click a day cell on the calendar grid to open the day details panel
Click "New Task" in the day details panel header
Enter the task name in the "Title" field
Select a due date using the date picker next to the Title field
Optionally enter task instructions in the "Description" textarea
Click the assignee dropdown and select an employee, or leave it as "Unassigned"
Click the recurrence dropdown and choose a repeat frequency (e.g. "Does not repeat", "Daily", or "Custom...")
If "Custom..." is selected, configure the recurrence interval and end conditions in the schedule builder modal
Click "Add Task" to save and schedule the new calendar task

workflows.title: How to edit or reassign a scheduled calendar task
workflows.purpose: Update the title, description, scheduled date, or assignee for a scheduled calendar task or task occurrence.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click on the calendar day cell containing the task you want to modify to open the day details panel
In the day details panel, click on the task row to expand its details
Click "Edit task" on the expanded task row to open the editing dialog
In the "Edit task" dialog, update the task name in the "Title" field
Update any instructions or task notes in the "Description" field
Click the "Date" field to select a new due date from the date picker
Click the "Assignee" dropdown and select a new team member to reassign the task
Click "Save changes" to save the task updates

workflows.title: How to cancel or delete a calendar task
workflows.purpose: Delete a one-time calendar task or choose whether to cancel a single occurrence or the entire series for a recurring task.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click on the calendar day cell containing the task you want to cancel or delete to open the day details drawer
In the day details drawer, click on the task row to expand its details and actions
Click "Delete" on the expanded task card
For a one-time task with no recurrence, the task is immediately removed without an extra confirmation dialog
For a recurring task, review the options presented in the "Confirm Cancellation" dialog
Click "This Instance Only" to cancel only the selected occurrence of the recurring task
Alternatively, click "Entire Series" to delete all scheduled occurrences of the task
Alternatively, click "Nevermind" to close the confirmation dialog without making changes

workflows.title: How to mark a calendar task complete
workflows.purpose: Mark a scheduled task occurrence complete directly from the calendar day drawer.
steps: Navigate to Testing program > Calendar
Click on the date containing the scheduled task in the calendar grid to open the day drawer
Click on the task title in the drawer list to expand the task details
Click "Mark Complete" to update the task occurrence to completed
Confirm the task occurrence is marked complete and the action button updates to "Mark Incomplete"

workflows.title: How to send continuing education reminder emails
workflows.purpose: Send email reminders to employees with incomplete or overdue continuing education requirements from the Continuing education tab.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Continuing education
Locate the target continuing education course in the course overview table.
Click the actions menu (three dots) on the course row and select "Send reminder" (or click "Send reminders" in the table header to notify all incomplete assignees).
In the "Send reminder emails" modal, review the list of recipients with incomplete or overdue course statuses.
Optionally enter additional instructions or context in the "Custom message" field.
Click "Send reminders" to dispatch the reminder emails to all selected employees.
Confirm the success toast notification indicates reminder emails were successfully sent.

workflows.title: How to notify an employee about an expired account connection
workflows.purpose: Send an email reminder prompting an employee to reconnect an expired or disconnected brokerage account from their profile.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Employees
Select and click on the employee from the list to open their profile details.
Click the "Accounts" tab on the employee profile.
Locate the account connection displaying an "Expired" status indicator.
Click the "Notify employee" button on the expired account card.
In the "Notify employee" dialog, review the email details and click "Send notification".

workflows.title: How an employee completes and signs a certification
workflows.purpose: An employee opens an assigned certification task, answers all required questions, reviews the Final disclaimer, and submits their electronic signature for compliance review.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Certifications
Under the "Pending" tab, click on the assigned certification to open the questionnaire.
Review the instructions and due date, then answer each question by selecting "Yes" or "No".
If prompted, enter additional context in the "Explanation" field or click "Upload attachment" to provide documentation.
Click "Next" to advance through the questionnaire sections to the "Final disclaimer".
Review the attestation statement and select the checkbox "I certify that the information provided is accurate and complete".
Type your legal name in the "Electronic signature" input field.
Click "Submit certification" to complete the submission for compliance review.

workflows.title: How to review and approve or reject a disclosure
workflows.purpose: Review assigned disclosure submissions from the queue, inspect submission details, and approve, reject, or send them back for corrections.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Disclosures
Click "Start review" to start the review queue, or click directly on any pending submission row.
Review the employee's submitted responses, conflict details, and uploaded documentation in the review pane.
Enter any internal comments or reviewer feedback in the "Review notes" field.
To approve the disclosure, click "Approve" and confirm by clicking "Confirm approval".
To reject the disclosure instead, click "Reject", enter the explanation in "Reason for rejection", and click "Confirm rejection".
To request revisions from the employee instead, click "Send back for corrections", enter the required changes in "Feedback", and click "Submit".

workflows.title: How to review and approve an employee's certification submission
workflows.purpose: Review an employee's submitted certification responses, evaluate flagged disclosures, add reviewer notes, and approve the submission.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Certifications
Click the "Submissions" tab to display all employee certification responses.
Filter by status "Pending review" and click "Review" on the target employee's submission row.
Inspect the submitted answers, paying special attention to questions highlighted with a "Flagged" badge.
Review any attached disclosure documents or explanations provided by the employee.
Optional: Enter compliance observations or audit remarks in the "Review notes" field.
Click the "Approve" button in the review drawer header.
In the confirmation modal, enter any final feedback in the "Approval comments" field and click "Confirm approval".

workflows.title: How to match an unclaimed brokerage account to an employee
workflows.purpose: Match unlinked brokerage feed accounts to the appropriate employee so that transactions and holdings are automatically pulled into compliance monitoring.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Unclaimed accounts
Locate the target unclaimed account in the list and click "Match account".
In the "Match account" dialog, click the "Select employee" dropdown.
Search for and select the corresponding employee name from the dropdown list.
Select the account ownership status under "Relationship" (e.g., "Self" or "Spouse / Dependent").
Click "Confirm match" to link the brokerage account to the employee profile.

workflows.title: How to deactivate or reactivate an employee
workflows.purpose: Deactivate an active employee to revoke access and unassign pending tasks, or reactivate a deactivated employee to restore their profile and permissions.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > People directory
Click on the active employee from the directory table to open their profile.
Click the "..." actions menu button in the upper-right corner of the employee profile.
Select "Deactivate employee" from the dropdown options.
Review the confirmation warning and click "Deactivate" to confirm removal of system access.
To restore an employee, click the "Status" filter in the People directory and select "Deactivated".
Click on the deactivated employee to open their profile details.
Click "Reactivate employee" and confirm by clicking "Reactivate" to restore their access and roles.

workflows.title: How to create a new trade flagging (monitoring) rule
workflows.purpose: Configure automated trade monitoring rules based on security lists, transaction thresholds, or trading patterns to flag employee trades for compliance review.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Trade monitoring
Click the "Settings" tab to access trade monitoring configuration.
Click "Add rule" to open the rule creation dialog.
Enter a descriptive name in the "Rule name" field.
Select the rule condition from the "Rule type" dropdown (e.g., "Cost basis threshold", "Restricted security list", or "Symbol pattern").
Configure the specific rule parameters and comparison thresholds.
Specify employee coverage under the "Applies to" section.
Click "Save rule" to activate the new flagging rule.

workflows.title: How to log a check manually in the Check Blotter
workflows.purpose: Manually record a client check received and forwarded, with duplicate detection before the record is saved to the Check Blotter.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Check blotter
Click "Log check" in the top-right toolbar to open the Log check dialog.
Ensure the "Manual entry" tab is selected.
Select the designated employee from the "Representative" dropdown (if logging on behalf of another user).
Enter the check amount in "Amount", the issuing party in "Issuer", and the recipient or firm name in "Payee".
Select the respective dates from the "Date received" and "Date forwarded" date pickers.
Enter the destination in "Forwarded to" and optionally enter the check identifier in "Check #".
Click "Log check" to submit the entry.
If a duplicate entry is detected, review the warning and click "Log check anyways" to proceed, or click "Cancel" to revise.

workflows.title: How to close a check as compliant or non-compliant
workflows.purpose: Open a logged check record in the Check blotter and resolve it by marking it Compliant or Non-compliant with an optional or required resolution note.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Check blotter
Click on a check record row in the list to open its detail view.

In the top action bar of the check detail view, confirm the check is resolvable: if it is archived or has been escalated to another admin, the "Compliant" and "Non-compliant" buttons will be disabled with a tooltip explaining why.
To close as compliant, click the "Compliant" button (shield-check icon) in the top action bar.
In the "Close as compliant" dialog, optionally enter a note in the "Resolution note (Optional)" field, e.g. "Approved by compliance review."
Click "Save" to resolve and stay on the same check, or click "Save & next" (or "Save & Close" if this is the last item in the list) to resolve and automatically advance to the next check.
To close as non-compliant instead, click the "Non-compliant" button (shield-ban icon) in the top action bar.
In the "Close as non-compliant" dialog, enter a note in the "Resolution note (Required)" field, e.g. "Violation of 24h rule confirmed." — the Save buttons stay disabled until this field is filled in.
Click "Save" to resolve and stay on the same check, or click "Save & next" / "Save & Close" to resolve and advance.

Confirm the resolution: a success toast reading "Check resolved." appears, and the check's status badge updates to reflect the compliant or non-compliant outcome; the note is also recorded in the check's audit trail.

workflows.title: How to bulk-update the review status of flagged trades
workflows.purpose: Select multiple flagged trades in the Trade monitoring table and update their review status to Not flagged, Flagged, Compliant, or Non-compliant simultaneously.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Trade monitoring
Click the "Status" filter dropdown above the table and select "Flagged" to filter for flagged trades.
Select the row checkboxes next to each trade you want to update, or check the header checkbox to select all visible trades.
Confirm the bulk actions toolbar appears showing "<N> trades selected".
Click the "Select status" dropdown menu in the bulk actions toolbar.
Choose the target review status: "Not flagged", "Flagged", "Compliant", or "Non-compliant".
Click "Update Status" to open the bulk update confirmation dialog.
Review the "Update <N> Trades" dialog summarizing the status change across all selected trades.
Click "Confirm" to apply the status update to the selected trades.
Verify the "Trades updated" success message appears as the table reflects the new review status.

workflows.title: How to upload or manually enter an employee's account holdings
workflows.purpose: Upload a statement file or manually enter initial holdings line items for an employee's brokerage account.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Accounts
Click the target employee's account row to open connection details
Click the "Holdings" tab
Click "Upload holdings" (if prompted with "Select an account", choose the account and click "Upload initial holdings")
On the "Upload initial holdings" page, click "Upload holdings" to import a statement file, or enter holdings manually in the table
In the "Upload holdings csv or excel sheet" dialog, click "Upload holdings file", map columns for "Symbol (or name)", "Quantity", and "Current total value", and click "Upload"
Review or manually edit rows by entering "Symbol (or name)", "Quantity", and "Current total value", using "Add new holding" for extra rows
Click "Submit" to validate the line items
In the "Submit initial holdings" confirmation dialog, click "Submit" to finalize the holdings

workflows.title: How to file a new Form U5
workflows.purpose: Initiate, complete, sign, and submit a Form U5 termination filing to FINRA for an employee leaving the firm.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > U5 filings
Click "File New U5" to open the U5 termination wizard.
In "Select employee", choose the representative being terminated, confirm the filing firm in "Select firm", and click "Next: General information".
Review personal details, verify or update fields in "Section 3: Current residential address", and click "Next: Termination information".
In "Section 1: Termination details", select Yes or No for "Is this a full termination?", select the "Reason for termination", choose the "Date terminated (MM/DD/YYYY)", and click "Next: Disclosures".
Answer the questions under each disclosure category or click "Answer \"No\" to all", then click "Next: Disclosure reporting pages".
Review any required Disclosure Reporting Pages (DRPs) and click "Next: Review".
Review all filing information and click "Save and proceed to signatures" to create the filing record.
Under "Firm acknowledgment", enter the contact person, telephone number, and signatory name, check the acknowledgment checkbox, and click "Sign firm acknowledgment".
Click "Validate filing" to run FINRA validation, click "File U5 to FINRA", and confirm by clicking "Submit filing" in the dialog.

workflows.title: How to file a new Form U4
workflows.purpose: Initiate and submit a Form U4 amendment filing for a representative to update registration information.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > U4 filings
Click "File New U4" to open the "Create new Form U4 filing" dialog
Select the "Amendment" option and click "Continue" to open the filing wizard
Under "Section 1: Select representative", search for the representative in "Search for a representative's name or email" and click their name from the results
Under "Section 2: Select amendment type", choose the desired amendment category (e.g. "State registration")
Click "Next: Enter amendment details" to advance to the details step
Complete the required registration fields on the "Enter details" step, then click "Next: Review & submit"
Review the amendment details on the "Review & submit" step and click "Continue to signatures" to submit the filing for signature

workflows.title: How to create and launch a certification campaign
workflows.purpose: Build a certification campaign in the 4-step wizard (Define, Audience, Schedule, Review) and launch it to dispatch tasks to employees.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Certifications
Click "New campaign" to open the campaign builder wizard
On the "Define" step, enter a name in the "Campaign name" field (e.g., "Q4 2025 Annual Certification")
Use the "Select one or more templates..." dropdown under "Included templates" to add one or more certification templates to the packet
Confirm the selected templates appear under "Selected certificate templates", then click "Next" to advance to the "Audience" step
Under "Select audience" > "Include", use "Search for groups or employees..." to add groups and/or individual employees, or toggle "Future new hires" to auto-assign the campaign to new employees
Optionally, under "Exclude", use "Search for groups or individuals to remove..." to exclude specific groups or employees from the audience
Click "Next" to advance to the "Schedule" step
Choose the round type: "One-time" or "Recurring"
For a one-time round, set the "Start date" and "Due by" dates using the date pickers
Click "Next" to advance to the "Review" step and confirm the campaign details
Click "Launch campaign" in the header
In the "Launch campaign" confirmation dialog, click "Launch" to confirm
Confirm the "Campaign created" success toast confirming the certification campaign has been created and launched

workflows.title: How to assign a new disclosure questionnaire to employees
workflows.purpose: Assign disclosure questionnaire templates to individual employees or employee groups and configure their reviewer workflow.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Disclosures
Click "Assign disclosures" to open the assignment wizard.
On the "Assign recipients" step, select the target recipients under "Employees" or "Employee groups".
Click "Next" to proceed to template selection.
On the "Select templates" step, check the box next to each disclosure questionnaire template you want to assign.
Click "Next" to configure reviewer settings.
On the "Initial reviewer" step, optionally select a reviewer and choose "Add to template defaults" or "Replace template defaults".
Click "Next" to configure the final reviewer.
On the "Final reviewer" step, select a reviewer and choose "Add to template defaults" or "Replace template defaults".
Click "Next" to proceed to the summary review, then click "Assign disclosures" to confirm and send the questionnaires.

workflows.title: How to add a new holding to an account statement
workflows.purpose: Navigate to an account statement and manually add a new holding line item with its security name, symbol, quantity, and total value.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > Accounts
In the Accounts table, click the arrow icon button on the row for the account containing the statement you want to edit
On the account details page, click "View & upload statements" to open the statements drawer
In the statements drawer, click the date-range link for the statement you want to edit
On the statement details page, click the "Holdings" tab
Click "Add new holding" to insert a new holding item row in edit mode
Enter the name of the security in the "Security name" input
Enter the ticker in the "Symbol" input
Enter the number of shares in the "Quantity" input and the position value in the "Total" input
Click the checkmark button to save the new holding

workflows.title: How to bulk import employees via CSV
workflows.purpose: Select multiple employees and transfer them to a different branch, automatically generating the related U4 filings.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > People directory
Click the "Branches" section in the sidebar to open the branch oversight dashboard
Click on a branch row in the branch list (e.g. under the "Branch" view) to open its detail page
Click the "Personnel" tab on the branch detail page
Select the checkboxes next to the employees you want to transfer in the Personnel table
Click "Transfer {N}" to open the bulk transfer dialog for the selected employees
In the "Transfer [N] employees to another branch" dialog, select the destination branch in "Transfer to branch"
Select the departure date in "End date at current branch"
Select the effective date in "Start date at new branch"
Click "Transfer to branch" to confirm and submit the bulk transfer
Review the "Filings created" confirmation screen showing the generated Form U4 (and Form BR, if applicable) amendments
Click "Continue to filings" to review the newly created U4 amendment filings, or "Close" to dismiss the dialog

workflows.title: How to file a new Form U5 for a departing representative
workflows.purpose: Submit a Form U5 termination filing to FINRA Gateway when a registered representative departs the firm.
steps: Navigate to Branches > FINRA
Click "New filing" to open the FINRA filing dialog.
Select "Form U5" under "Filing type".
Select the departing individual from the "Representative" dropdown.
Choose the termination scope under "Termination type" (e.g., "Full termination").
Enter or select the effective departure date in "Termination date".
Select the appropriate departure reason under "Reason for termination" (e.g., "Voluntary", "Discharged", or "Permitted to resign").
Complete the required compliance inquiries under "Disclosure questions".
Enter additional context in "Termination explanation" if required for the selected reason.
Click "Submit filing" to finalize and submit the Form U5 to FINRA.

workflows.title: How to issue a remediation follow-up to a branch
workflows.purpose: Issue a remediation follow-up to a branch by selecting open exam findings, entering corrective instructions and a due date, and sending the request to branch contacts.
steps: Navigate to Branches > Branch exams
Click on the relevant branch exam from the list to open the exam details page.
Click the "Remediations" tab.
Select the checkboxes next to the open remediation items requiring additional response.
Click "Issue follow-up" in the table action toolbar.
Enter specific guidance or requested corrections in the "Follow-up notes" field.
Select a target response deadline in the "Due date" field.
Click "Send follow-up" to notify the branch and update the remediation status.

workflows.title: How to export a branch exam's remediation tracker to CSV
workflows.purpose: Export the remediation tracker items for a branch exam to a CSV file from the exam details view.
steps: Navigate to Branches > Branch exams
Click on the desired branch exam in the table to open its details view.
Click the "Remediation tracker" tab.
Optionally filter the items by entering keywords in the search bar or filtering by "Status".
Click "Export CSV" to download the remediation tracker records as a CSV file.

workflows.title: How to delete or reject U4 filings in bulk
workflows.purpose: Remove unsubmitted U4 filings or reject pending amendments in bulk from the FINRA filings table.
steps: Navigate to Branches > FINRA
Click the "Status" filter dropdown to filter for "Draft" filings to delete or "Pending review" filings to reject.
Select the checkboxes next to each target U4 filing, or select the header checkbox to select all visible rows.
In the bulk action toolbar, click "Delete" to delete unsubmitted drafts or "Reject" to reject pending filings.
In the confirmation dialog, enter any required notes in "Rejection reason" if rejecting.
Click "Confirm" to execute the bulk action and update the filings list.

workflows.title: How to download a branch exam's audit trail
workflows.purpose: Export the comprehensive chronological history of all activities, status changes, and reviewer actions on a branch exam as a CSV file.
steps: Navigate to Branches > Branch exams
Locate the target branch exam in the table and click on the exam name to open the exam details.
Click the "Actions" button in the top-right header of the exam page.
Click "Download audit trail" from the dropdown menu.
Save the generated audit trail CSV file to your local computer for compliance recordkeeping.

workflows.title: How to edit a branch's display name in Branches
workflows.purpose: Update a branch's custom display name in Hadrius without altering its official regulatory FINRA or SEC record.
steps: Navigate to Branches > Branches
Locate and click on the target branch in the branches table to open its detail view.
Click "Edit branch" in the branch overview header.
Click into the "Display name" input field and enter the new custom display name.
Click "Save changes" to apply the updated branch display name.

workflows.title: How to connect Hadrius to the FINRA Gateway in Branches
workflows.purpose: Connect Hadrius to the FINRA Gateway from the Branches dashboard to automatically sync official Form BR branch data.
steps: Navigate to Branches > Branch dashboard
Click "Add branch" to open the "Add a location" dialog.
Under "Regulatory regime", select the "FINRA" radio option.
Under the FINRA options, select "Sync an existing branch" to pull Form BR data directly from the FINRA Gateway.
Click "Next" to automatically prompt the "Automate your setup by connecting to FINRA" credential dialog.
In the "Permissions" multi-select, select "BR", "U4", and/or "U5" to grant form access.
Enter your firm's FINRA Gateway credentials into "Client ID" and "Client secret".
Select an "Expiration date" for the credential and verify "Set as default credential" is checked.
Click "Save & Test Connection" to validate and establish the FINRA Gateway connection.
Enter the "Branch #CRD number" and click "Find & sync branch" to verify the connection and import your branch's Form BR data.

workflows.title: How to bulk sign, validate, and submit U4 filings
workflows.purpose: Bulk sign 15E compliance signatures, validate against FINRA rules, and submit multiple U4 filings simultaneously from the U4 filings directory.
steps: Navigate to People oversight > U4 filings
In the U4 filings directory table, select the checkboxes next to the employee filings you want to process, or select the table header checkbox to select all filings on the page.
In the selection banner above the table, click "Sign [N]" to open the "Bulk Sign Filings" dialog.
In the "Signature Details" section, click into the "15E Signatory Name" field and enter your full name.
Review the candidate filings under "The following N filings will be signed", then click "Sign N filing(s)" to begin bulk signing.
Wait for the progress bar to show "Progress: X/N completed"; if any filing returns an error, click "Retry N failed filing(s)" to re-attempt signing.
Once all filings are successfully signed, click "Next: Validate" to transition directly into the "Bulk validate filings" dialog.
Review the list of signed filings, then click "Validate N filing(s)" to trigger validation checks against FINRA schema requirements.
Monitor the validation progress until completed (if any validation errors occur, resolve the flagged fields and click "Retry N failed filing(s)").
Once filings attain "READY_TO_FILE" status, click "File N filing(s) to FINRA" to submit the filings directly.

workflows.title: How to add a new branch

Select an existing employee in the "Employee" field
Choose the FINRA branch role in the "FINRA Role" dropdown (Supervisor, OSJ supervisor, Person in Charge, or Staff)
Pick a start date in the "Start Date" field
Click "Add to list" to queue the employee entry (repeat for additional employees if needed)
Click "Add {N} employee(s)" to submit the queued personnel entries
If FINRA filings were auto-generated, review the "Filings created" screen (Form BR Amendment / Form U4 Amendments) and click "View filing" as needed, then click "Done" to close

workflows.title: How to schedule a new branch exam

workflows.title: How to complete and submit a branch exam task questionnaire

Click "Add template" to open the template dialog
Enter a descriptive name for the template in the "Title" field
Enter the reusable review feedback text in the "Body" field
Click "Save" to add the template to the local list
(Optional) Click the pencil icon next to an existing template to modify its "Title" or "Body", then click "Save"
(Optional) Click the trash icon next to an existing template to delete it from the list
Click "Save changes" in the upper right corner to persist the comment templates

workflows.title: How to configure marketing document types
workflows.purpose: Configure, create, toggle, and manage custom document type categories available for marketing project submissions.
steps: Navigate to Marketing > Settings
Select the "Document types" tab.
Click "Add document type" to open the creation dialog.
Enter the name of the new category in the "Document type" input field.
Click "Add type" to add the document type to the library.
Toggle the active switch in any document type's row to enable or disable it for marketing submissions.
Click the actions menu on an existing custom document type row to access management options.
Select "Edit", update the name in the "Document type" field, and click "Save changes".
Select "Delete" for an unused custom type and confirm by clicking "Delete type" in the confirmation dialog.
Click "Save changes" in the page header to persist all document type configurations.

workflows.title: How to move a project card through the review kanban board
workflows.purpose: Review and approve marketing materials within a project to advance its card through the kanban review stages.
steps: Navigate to Marketing > Projects & Documents
Click "Projects" to display the review kanban board view.
Under the "For my attention" column, locate the project card that needs review.
Click the project card or open its "..." actions menu and select "View" to enter the review workspace.
Review the submitted materials and flags, then click "Approve document" in the upper action toolbar.
In the "Approve document" confirmation dialog, enter any optional review notes in the "Comments" field.
Click "Approve document" to confirm your decision and advance the project's workflow status.
Click "Back to projects" to return to the kanban board and confirm the card has moved from "For my attention" to "Resolved".

workflows.title: How to add context to Firm Intelligence
workflows.purpose: Ask a natural-language question against firm context and receive a sourced answer, saved as a chat thread.
steps: Navigate to Marketing > Intelligence
Enter your question in the prompt textarea (e.g. "What's our policy on accepting gifts from clients?")
Click "Submit" (the up-arrow send button) to send the question — or press Enter
Wait for the app to create a new chat and post your question as the first turn — you are redirected automatically to the new chat thread
Review the sourced answer rendered in the chat transcript, shown as an assistant finding card with citations
Optionally click "Save context" on the answer card to persist the finding, if it is not already completed
Ask a follow-up question in the thread composer to continue the conversation, which is saved to the same chat thread

workflows.title: How to edit or manage a Firm Intelligence finding
workflows.purpose: Review, edit, confirm, or delete findings extracted from source documents in Firm Intelligence.
steps: Navigate to Marketing > Intelligence
Click "Manage context" to open the context management page.
Click the source document accordion row to expand its extracted findings.
Click the view icon on the target finding row to open the finding details drawer.
Click "Edit" in the finding details drawer to open the "Edit finding" dialog.
Update the title and edit the finding text in the content field.
Click "Save changes" to update the finding.
Alternatively, click "Save Context" to confirm and accept a finding awaiting review.
To remove an unwanted finding, click "Delete", then click "Delete" in the "Delete finding?" confirmation dialog.

workflows.title: How to reopen a closed exception in Account surveillance
workflows.purpose: Locate a previously resolved exception in Account surveillance and reopen it for active compliance review.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Exceptions
Click the "Status" filter dropdown and select "Closed" to view closed exceptions.
Click on the closed exception row to open the exception details drawer.
Click the "Reopen exception" button in the drawer header.
Enter the rationale in the "Reason for reopening" field.
Click "Confirm" to reopen the exception and move it back to the open review queue.

workflows.title: How to archive a flagged exception
workflows.purpose: Review a flagged surveillance exception and archive it with an audit-ready resolution reason.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Exceptions
Click on the flagged exception from the list to open the exception details panel.
Click "Archive" in the action bar at the top of the details panel.
In the "Archive exception" dialog, enter the explanation in the "Reason" field.
Click "Archive" to confirm and close the exception.
Verify that the status updates to "Archived" and the item is archived from active exceptions.

workflows.title: How to save and reuse a custom trade search
workflows.purpose: Configure custom trade filters on the trade blotter and save them as a named search to quickly reapply the same criteria later.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Trades
Click "Filter" to open the trade filter options.
Set your desired filter criteria (such as date range, symbol, transaction type, or account) and click "Apply".
Click "Save search" next to the active filters.
Enter a descriptive name for your search in the "Search name" field.
Click "Save" to store the custom trade search.
To reuse the search, click the "Saved searches" dropdown menu above the trade table.
Select the saved search name from the list to instantly reapply all saved filter parameters.

workflows.title: How to escalate a flagged compliance exception
workflows.purpose: Escalate a flagged compliance exception in Account surveillance to a supervisor or senior compliance officer with an escalation rationale and assignment.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Exceptions
Locate and click on the flagged exception record in the table to open the exception details drawer.
Click "Escalate" in the review actions panel.
In the "Escalate exception" dialog, click the "Assign to" dropdown and select the designated reviewer.
Enter the compliance justification in the "Reason" field.
Enter any supporting context or findings in the "Notes" text box.
Click "Escalate exception" to submit the escalation and update the status badge to "Escalated".

workflows.title: How to close a flagged compliance exception
workflows.purpose: Review and close a flagged account or trade surveillance exception by documenting a compliance determination and resolution notes.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Exceptions
Click on the flagged exception row in the active exceptions table to open the details panel.
Review the triggered surveillance rule, transaction details, and compliance risk analysis.
Click "Resolve exception" in the top action bar.
Select the resolution outcome from the "Determination" dropdown (e.g., "No violation / False positive" or "Resolved with rep").
Enter the compliance justification and audit trail rationale in the "Resolution notes" field.
Click "Close exception" to confirm the resolution and move the item to the closed queue.

workflows.title: How to bulk close multiple flagged exceptions at once
workflows.purpose: An admin selects several flagged exceptions in the alerts table and closes them all together after entering a single audit reason.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Overview

Optionally use the filter chips ("High risk", "Medium risk", "Low risk", "New", "Under review", "Resolved", "Escalated", "Assigned to me", "Sandbox") or the "Filter by rule" dropdown to narrow down the flags you want to close.
In the table header row, click the header checkbox to select all flags on the current page, or click the row checkbox next to each individual flag you want to close.
In the bulk action bar that appears above the table showing the selected count (e.g. "3 flags selected"), click "Close".
In the "Close flags" confirmation dialog, enter a summary in the "Reason" textarea (this is required and stored in the audit record for each flag).
Click "Close <count> flags" to confirm.
Wait for the dialog to close and the selection to clear — the closed flags now show a "Resolved" status badge in the table.

workflows.title: How to import trade and holdings data
workflows.purpose: Select a custodian and upload a CSV or XLSX file containing trades and holdings for automated surveillance processing.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Import data
Click the "Select a custodian" dropdown to view available custodians
Select the custodian matching your source file from the dropdown list
Click the "Input CSV/XLSX" file upload area to choose a file from your computer
Select the .csv or .xlsx file containing your trade and holdings records
Click "Upload and Proceed" to submit the data file for ingestion
Confirm the "Upload successful" toast notification indicating your trades and holdings are processing

workflows.title: How to create a new surveillance rule from a template
workflows.purpose: Browse surveillance rule templates and configure detection thresholds, accounts, and severity using the rule creation wizard.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Overview
Click "Rule library" to open the surveillance rules page.
Click "Create new rule" to browse available templates.
On the "Select a rule template" page, locate your target template card (such as "Front running", "Wash trading", or "Churning") and click "Use this template".
In the "Name & overview" step of the wizard, enter a name in "Rule name" and an optional description in "Description".
Click "Next" to advance through "Detection parameters", "Security matching", and "Pattern & escalation" to set your detection window and thresholds.
In the "Accounts & groups" step, configure target accounts or search specific groups to exclude, then click "Next".
In the "Activation & severity" step, select an activation option (e.g. "Activate on publish") and choose a severity level (e.g. "Moderate").
Click "Next" to reach "Review & publish", verify the rule summary, and click "Publish".

workflows.title: How to edit a surveillance rule's configuration
workflows.purpose: Open an existing surveillance rule and update its detection parameters, severity level, and threshold configurations.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Rules
Locate the surveillance rule you wish to configure and click "Edit" on its row.
In the rule configuration panel, update the rule details such as "Rule name", "Description", or "Severity".
Adjust the template-specific detection parameters and thresholds under "Parameters" (e.g., lookback windows or threshold amounts).
Toggle "Active" to enable or disable rule enforcement as needed.
Click "Save changes" to apply the updated configuration.

workflows.title: How to activate, deactivate, or sandbox a surveillance rule
workflows.purpose: Toggle a surveillance rule between active, inactive, and sandbox deployment statuses to manage alert generation.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Rule library
Locate the target rule row in the table and check its current state in the "Status" column
Click the "..." actions menu button on the right side of the rule row
To enable an inactive or sandboxed rule, click "Activate" in the dropdown menu
To deactivate or sandbox an active rule, click "Deactivate" in the dropdown menu to open the "Deactivate Rule" dialog
In the "Deactivate Rule" modal, choose either "Inactive" to turn off evaluations completely or "Sandbox" to test silently without generating alerts
Click "Confirm" to apply the selected status, or click "Cancel" to close the dialog without changes
Verify the updated status badge in the "Status" column, or filter by the "Active", "Sandbox", or "Inactive" tabs above the table

workflows.title: How to manually run a surveillance rule
workflows.purpose: Queue an on-demand run of a rule outside its normal schedule and view the resulting rule run.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Rule library
Click the row actions menu (kebab icon) for the target rule in the rules table
Click "Run now" in the dropdown menu
Wait for the "Rule run queued" confirmation toast confirming the run was queued
You are automatically redirected to the new rule run's results page
Review the rule run results, including its processing status and alerts, on the "<Rule name> - Results" page

workflows.title: How to view a rule run's results
workflows.purpose: Inspect the status, execution metrics, and generated alerts of a specific rule run in Account surveillance.

In the rules table, locate the target rule and click the timestamp displayed in the "Last run" column to open its execution results

workflows.title: How to build and manage client-company relationships
workflows.purpose: Visualize client, representative, and account ownership hierarchies and link entities together using the interactive relationship graph.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Company structure
Wait for the graph canvas to load until the "Loading relationship data..." indicator disappears and the "Client Relationship Builder" workspace is visible.
Use the bottom-left ReactFlow navigation controls to zoom or fit the view to locate the desired source and target entity nodes.
Locate the circular connection handle on the source entity node (e.g. representative or client).
Click and hold the source node handle, then drag the connecting edge across to the target node handle (e.g. client or account).
Release the connection line onto the target handle to create the new relationship.
Verify that the "Creating relationship..." status indicator displays in the bottom-right corner while the relationship is being saved.
Confirm the newly created relationship edge renders on the canvas with its assigned relationship label (such as "OWNS" or "MANAGES").

workflows.title: How to search and filter representatives
workflows.purpose: Search representatives by first or last name and filter the roster by active or inactive status.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Representatives
Enter a representative's name into the "Search first or last name..." field
Click the "Active" filter chip to view only active representatives
Click the "Inactive" filter chip to view only inactive representatives
Click the "All statuses" filter chip to clear the status filter and show all representatives
Click the clear icon in the "Search first or last name..." input to reset the search query

workflows.title: How to monitor incoming data feed sync status
workflows.purpose: Review and filter incoming custodian data feed syncs by source, status, and file type to identify failed or delayed imports.
steps: Navigate to Account surveillance > Feed monitor
Enter a search term in the "Search" input field to filter syncs by source, status, or filename
Click the "All sources" dropdown and select a specific data feed source to quickly narrow down the list
Click "Filters" to open the "Feed filters" drawer
In the "Feed filters" drawer, select one or more checkboxes under "Source" to filter by custodian or data feed provider
Under "Status", select checkboxes such as "Failed" or "Delayed" to isolate problematic syncs
Under "File type", select the relevant file format checkboxes to filter by imported data type
Click "Search" in the drawer to apply the selected filters and update the data feed list
Review the table columns including "Source", "Sync date", "Status", "File type", and "Filename" to evaluate feed health
Click "Clear all" to reset all applied filters and display all data feed sync records
